svg.title: ACT inference pipeline on the NexArm
svg.desc: Three camera frames and the six joint angles go in. A ResNet18 turns each frame into 300 tokens; with a state token and a style-latent token that is zero at inference they form 902 tokens. Four encoder layers mix them, one decoder layer with 100 query slots reads the result, and a linear layer gives 100 joint targets, all of which the arm runs before it looks again.
svg.text: ACT turns one look into 100 actions.
